text:
pagerbot: @alex pager duty alert: suspicious auth proxy traffic pattern detected for tenant acme-prod. severity=P2. 3 source IPs showing HMAC header reuse. https://incidents.internal/6181234321

alex: ack I'm on it. can someone paste sample header + path?

maria: copying samples from obs stream — pattern: Authorization: HMAC id=svc-frontend,nonce=...,sig=REUSED_SIG

ben: confirmed same signature across different src IPs and user-agents. looks like replay against edge proxies not origin. throttling rules not tripping.

alex: taking ownership. will apply ipblock and rate-limit at edge. @tina please assess customer impact and hold off external comms until legal ok.

ben: planning rule:
```
# nginx edge ip block
if ($remote_addr ~ "^(203\.0\.113\.45|198\.51\.100\.22|192\.0\.2\.9)$") {
  return 403;
}
```
rolling to canary in prod-edge-1 now.

deploy-bot: rollout started: edge-waf-rule v2026.03.18-1 -> prod-edge-1

maria: also see rapid auth header replays targeting /v1/stream and /v1/embeddings endpoints. tenant header acme-prod present. no data exfil spikes in pg logs so far.

tina: ACME-CS on call. Their metrics show some 401->200 delta ~2% of requests; users reporting a few failed requests earlier. I'll draft a careful status to send once legal signs off.

sarah: on legal. need timeline + affected keys + whether PII touched. do not disclose internal mitigations. if rotation decided, provide rotation window and customer guidance.

alex: ip block applied to all edges. canary shows blocked 95% of offending traffic. will rotate svc-frontend key for acme-prod next 10m and coord with infra to revoke old tokens.

maria: creating short forensics checklist: list of affected keys, affected IPs, sample requests, earliest seen ts, hit counts. pushing to incident doc: https://incidents.internal/6181234321/doc

tina: prepping customer note draft: short, non-alarmist, recommend key rotation, steps we will take. share here for approval in 10m.

sarah: approved high-level text. cc @alex when rotation complete so legal gets final timeline.

alex: rotation scheduled, running keyswap job: `/opt/tools/keyrotate --tenant acme-prod --service svc-frontend --force --notify=cs,legal` started.

deploy-bot: keyrotate job 8921 started on infra-runner-3

ben: monitoring for regressions. if we see >1% user impact we will revert rule. so far so good.

alex: closing on-call loop: will hand to sec oncall for postmortem. leaving notes in incident channel. :thumbsup:
